text: I keep thinking about what happened yesterday.
I cannot stop thinking about my past mistakes.
I keep replaying that conversation in my head.
Everything that happened was all my fault.
I keep worrying about what might happen in the future.
No matter what I do, I keep coming back to the same problem.
I keep blaming myself for everything.
I cannot get that incident out of my head.
I am feeling sad today.
My examination is scheduled for tomorrow.
I went to college and attended my lectures.
I am happy because I completed my assignment.
Yesterday I watched a movie with my friends.
I made a mistake, but I learned from it and moved forward.
I do not keep thinking about what happened.
I can stop thinking about my past mistakes.
I am not constantly worrying about the future.
I do not blame myself for what happened.
My friend keeps thinking about what happened yesterday.
She cannot stop thinking about her past mistakes.
He keeps blaming himself for everything.
They keep worrying about what might happen.
I was thinking about my examination yesterday.
What if I fail my examination?
I should have prepared better for the examination.
I keep thinking about the new project.
